data.gender_notes: Victus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vicere', meaning 'to conquer' or 'to rule'. In Christian tradition, the name Victus symbolizes triumph over adversity and faith in God's power. The name Victus carries the meaning “Conquering, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Victus usually hope their child will grow to embody conquering, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the triumph of good over evil, and the victory of the soul over the body and the material world.
data.etymology: Victus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquering, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victus total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Victus

data.cultural_impact: The name Victus carries a sense of victory and achievement, reflecting the Christian belief in conquering challenges and hardships with faith and perseverance. It is a name that resonates with strength and determination, inspiring those who bear it to strive for greatness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a Christian perspective, the name Victus represents the spiritual victory that comes from trusting in God's grace and power. It is a reminder that no matter what trials and tribulations one may face, with faith and perseverance, they can overcome adversity and emerge victorious. Ultimately, the name Victus celebrates the truth that even in the darkest moments, God remains our ultimate triumph and source of strength.
